# API reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Configuration and data

The subject file, the observations CSV and its validation, and the daily bookkeeping.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [config](config.qmd#wdm.config) | Subject metadata, goals, and safety limits. |
| [schema](schema.qmd#wdm.schema) | CSV column definitions and validation. |
| [io](io.qmd#wdm.io) | Loading observations from CSV into episode arrays. |
| [daily](daily.qmd#wdm.daily) | The morning routine's bookkeeping: record today's readings, keep a plan log. |
| [constants](constants.qmd#wdm.constants) | Physiological and unit constants, with provenance. |

State and parameter types, the physiology, the step map, the observations.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [models.types](models.types.qmd#wdm.models.types) | Core datatypes: model state, parameters, and daily inputs. |

| [models.glycogen](models.glycogen.qmd#wdm.models.glycogen) | Fast water compartments: glycogen-bound and sodium-associated water. |
| [models.dynamics](models.dynamics.qmd#wdm.models.dynamics) | The continuous-time model, its one-day step map, and the process-noise model. |

## Filters

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [filters.common](filters.common.qmd#wdm.filters.common) | Shared filter types and numerical helpers. |

| [filters.ukf](filters.ukf.qmd#wdm.filters.ukf) | Unscented (sigma-point) Kalman filter and smoother. |
| [filters.ekf](filters.ekf.qmd#wdm.filters.ekf) | Extended Kalman filter using JAX automatic differentiation. |
